name: productname-canvas-mcp
description: Local-first student Canvas automation — organize and complete academic fluff.
long_description: ProductName Canvas MCP is a local-first, student-only server (~40 tools) for Canvas LMS: courses, assignments, submissions (preview→confirm), discussions, modules, files, and messaging. It runs as a stdio MCP server using your Canvas API token and/or SSO sync — every action runs under your own Canvas role and audit trail. Exams, proctored tools, and LTI submits stay human-only.

canvas_api_url.title: Canvas API URL
canvas_api_url.description: Your institution's Canvas base URL, e.g. https://canvas.example.edu

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas API Token
canvas_api_token.description: A Canvas personal access token (Account → Settings → New Access Token). Stored securely in your OS keychain. Optional when using SSO sync.
